Primary request: Generate a restrained black-and-white interview portrait of Darius King at exact age 40, calculated from fictional birthdate 1978-02-18. This is a new independent photograph, not an edit, poster, collage or contact sheet.

Input images: Image 1 is Darius's primary canonical illustrated identity and design reference. Image 2 is his secondary live-action facial realism reference. Preserve the same distinct fictional South African Black man: deep brown skin rendered naturally in monochrome, long oval face, strong cheekbones, dark eyes, short high-top black hair, neat mustache, athletic build, and exact age 40. Use Image 2 for natural skin and facial realism only. Do not copy either reference pose, tan suit, brown airport jacket, shoulder bag, broad smile, cream background, outdoor terminal, lighting or camera angle.

Scene/backdrop: a quiet 2018 press interview in a spare concrete screening-room foyer, with one upholstered chair, a small side table, an out-of-focus handheld recorder low at the extreme foreground, and no readable signage.

Subject/action: Darius sits sideways near the right third of frame, torso turned partly away from the camera, one elbow resting low on the chair arm and one hand loosely open mid-explanation. He looks past the left edge toward an unseen interviewer. Both hands are naturally visible and relaxed.
Style/medium: authentic contemporary black-and-white editorial portrait on fine-grain digital monochrome, natural pores and fabric texture, restrained contrast, minimal retouching.

Composition/framing: true vertical 2:3 frame from slightly below seated eye level; three-quarter-length seated portrait with asymmetrical negative concrete space above-left; no square crop, headshot, symmetrical shoulders or direct gaze.
Hair: clean short high-top with a slightly softer natural curl line than the canonical sheet, neat mustache unchanged, no beard.
Expression/gaze: thoughtful and measured mid-sentence expression, brows gently raised, mouth just parting, eyes fixed on the interviewer off-axis; no smile at the lens.
Wardrobe: charcoal open-collar knit polo and dark pleated trousers, no jacket, suit, tie, watch display or shoulder bag.
Lighting/mood: broad window light from far left, soft falloff, quiet intelligence and reserve; no glamour rim light.

Constraints: clearly adult age 40; preserve fictional facial identity; plausible 2018 interview environment and styling; natural hands and anatomy; exactly one person; no text, logos, watermark, border, split panels, collage or contact sheet.

Avoid: direct camera gaze, broad smile, airport, tan or brown outerwear, standing pose, crossed arms, microphone held near face, warm sepia, celebrity resemblance, plastic skin, malformed hands, extra limbs.
